scenarios.name: Starting a new application
scenarios.prompt: Build a small local notes CLI from scratch with add/list/search/delete, JSON persistence and standard-library tests.
expectations: A working CLI with the requested commands and persistence
Standard-library tests that exercise add/list/search/delete and persistence
An ECR with scope, acceptance, design decision, implementation and verification
A README with exact commands and a stated limitation
No invented implementation or deployment evidence
failure_signals: Builds a framework or adds dependencies without need
Claims tests passed without running them
Produces no requirements or design record
Leaves acceptance criteria unimplemented without saying so

scenarios.name: Adding a feature to an existing application
scenarios.prompt: Add tags and list-by-tag filtering to the task CLI while preserving existing JSON compatibility and behavior.
expectations: Tags and tag filtering work for pending and all tasks
Existing add/list/done behavior and old JSON files remain compatible
Tests cover the new behavior and preserve existing tests
The ECR and design record describe the actual change, not a rewrite
No unrelated refactor or scope expansion
failure_signals: Breaks existing JSON or command behavior
Rewrites the application instead of extending it
Adds a filter that only works for the happy path
Leaves existing tests failing or removes them

scenarios.name: Fixing a defect in an existing application
scenarios.prompt: Reproduce and fix the pagination off-by-one with the smallest correct change, preserve the public contract and add regression coverage.
expectations: The original failure is reproduced before the repair
The fix is minimal and preserves signatures and validation
Regression tests fail before the fix and pass after it
The ECR separates reproduction, cause, repair and verification
No unrelated refactor or release claim
failure_signals: Changes the public contract to make the tests pass
Claims reproduction without observing the failure
Adds broad refactoring to a one-line defect
Reports release or production verification without evidence

scenarios.name: Ideating and carrying through to implementation
scenarios.prompt: Turn a rough habit-tracker idea into a useful local CLI slice with explicit streak and missed-day behavior, then implement, test and review it.
expectations: A bounded product outcome and observable acceptance replace the vague idea
Streak and missed-day behavior are explicitly decided
A useful slice is implemented and tested, not an unbounded platform
The product, ECR, design and verification records agree
Open ideas are deferred rather than silently dropped or half-built
failure_signals: Implements every imagined feature without a slice decision
Leaves streak or missed-day semantics implicit
Produces a plan but no implementation
Claims a product outcome without tests or observed behavior
